title: OpenAI may announce a ChatGPT smart speaker this year
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's first device is set to be a smart speaker that lets you talk with ChatGPT, according to a report from Bloomberg . The device apparently won't have a screen, but will use a camera and additional sensors to "understand" your environment. The report comes just days after Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI that accused the AI company of stealing hardware secrets . OpenAI, in a new statement on Tuesday , said that it is "not aware of any evidence that this complaint has merit." summary: 据彭博社报道，OpenAI 计划于今年发布首款硬件设备——一款无屏幕的 ChatGPT 智能音箱，配备摄像头和传感器以理解环境，支持可充电电池。此举标志着 OpenAI 从软件向硬件的战略延伸，但正值苹果起诉 OpenAI 窃取硬件商业秘密之际，引发行业关注。

title: SpaceXAI’s Grok programming tool was uploading its users’ entire codebase to cloud storage
raw_excerpt: SpaceXAI's Grok Build AI coding tool was spotted uploading users' entire codebases to Google Cloud before it was reported, and the company turned it off. The Register reports that Cereblab published findings on Monday showing how the Grok Build CLI was packaging and uploading entire code repositories, "including files it was told not to open and secrets deleted from history," significantly more data retention than similar tools like Claude Code. The researchers say that as of Monday, their tests show SpaceXAI's servers returning a "disable_codebase_upload: true" flag, and the codebase upload "no longer fires." Elon Musk responded to the i … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: SpaceXAI 的 Grok Build 编程工具被曝将用户整个代码库上传至 Google Cloud，包括被指示忽略的文件和已删除的密钥。Cereblab 发布报告后，SpaceXAI 已禁用该功能。此事引发对 AI 编程工具数据隐私与安全性的广泛担忧。

title: Better Call Sol: The Workhorse
raw_excerpt: Zvi Mowshowitz argued GPT-5.6 Sol delivers the strongest balance of reasoning quality, speed, and cost among current frontier models, making it the default choice for demanding knowledge work. He highlights its long-horizon execution, effective computer use, and agentic workflows while noting that task-specific model selection still matters for peak performance.
summary: Zvi Mowshowitz 发文称 GPT-5.6 Sol 在推理质量、速度和成本之间取得了最佳平衡，成为当前前沿模型中的首选，尤其适合长时执行、计算机使用和智能体工作流。同时指出，针对特定任务选择模型仍很重要。

title: Open-Weight Models Reached 29% of AI Gateway Usage
raw_excerpt: Vercel reported that open-weight models handled 29% of AI Gateway token volume in June while accounting for less than 4% of spending.
summary: Vercel 报告显示，2026 年 6 月开源权重模型在其 AI 网关中处理了 29% 的 token 量，但花费占比不到 4%。这一数据表明开源模型在成本效益上具有显著优势，正逐渐在生产环境中占据重要地位。

title: Video Generators as General-Purpose Vision Models
raw_excerpt: DeepMind researchers introduced GenCeption, which repurposes a pretrained video generation model as a unified vision system controlled through text instructions.
summary: DeepMind 提出 GenCeption 方法，将预训练的视频生成模型重新用作通用视觉系统，通过文本指令控制。该方法无需额外训练即可完成多种视觉任务，展示了视频生成模型作为统一视觉基础模型的潜力。

title: Today, we are releasing verifiers v1
raw_excerpt: Prime Intellect's verifiers v1 is an overhaul of its environment stack for the modern era of agentic RL and evals. It decomposes environments into a task set, a harness, and a runtime. verifiers v1 enables complex agentic tasks like coding and computer use at scale in any harness.
summary: Prime Intellect 发布 verifiers v1，对其环境栈进行全面改造，以支持现代智能体强化学习和评估。verifiers v1 将环境分解为任务集、框架和运行时三部分，支持大规模编码和计算机使用等复杂智能体任务。

title: Smart Cellular Bricks: Towards Collective Intelligence for the Physical World
raw_excerpt: Sakana AI's research on collective intelligence has extended into physical hardware with "Smart Cellular Bricks." These bricks employ local communication and neural networks to autonomously classify and reconstruct 3D shapes without centralized control. In experiments, the system achieved high accuracy in shape classification and demonstrated robustness against noise and module failures.
summary: Sakana AI 将集体智能研究扩展到物理硬件，推出“智能细胞砖”。这些砖块通过局部通信和神经网络自主分类和重建 3D 形状，无需集中控制。实验表明系统在形状分类上具有高精度，且对噪声和模块故障具有鲁棒性。
